verificationCommands: Chief-authored argv arrays; merger does not re-run them

invariants.runtimeAndProject: distinct git repositories; git-common-dir must differ; neither may nest the other
invariants.stateRoot: ordinary directory outside both git repos and the task pool; no symlink
invariants.poolRoot: created by the target repo, never equal to projectRoot, shares git-common-dir only with projectRoot

cleanupRollback.note: On failure keep the registered target baseline. Do not git reset the runtime repo. Do not enable LaunchAgents.
